prompts.text: Which look from me still makes you stop mid-sentence?
We have one unexpected hour together before a busy week. Where are you taking us?
A playful message during a long meeting or a surprise dessert waiting at home?
Flirting should never stop simply because two people know each other well. Agree?
Tell me about a moment between us that still makes you grin when nobody is watching.
What tiny thing do I do that makes you feel pursued all over again?
We decide to recreate our first date, but one detail has to change. What are you changing?
A familiar smile across a crowded room still feels like a private conversation. Do you get the same feeling?
A dress-up date somewhere new or an evening dancing badly in our living room?
Which compliment from me would you like to hear more often?
You get to plan a surprise without spending money. What's your opening move?
What's the funniest time one of us tried to act smooth and failed completely?
What part of our ordinary routine deserves a little more romance?
Keeping a little anticipation in a relationship makes everyday plans more fun. What's your view?
A slow breakfast together or a late-night drive with our favourite songs?
We each write three clues for a mystery date. What would your first clue say?
What makes you feel most noticed when we're out together?
Which inside joke of ours would make absolutely no sense to anyone else?
It's funny how the same old nickname starts sounding sweeter after a long day apart. True?
How do you like me to remind you I still have a crush on you?
Stealing a dance while cooking or sharing a sofa and rating terrible films?
We swap roles and plan a date in each other's style. What surprise would I find?
Which picture of us tells a story our friends don't know?
A couple who laugh at themselves have a better time on dates than a couple chasing perfection. Agree?
I'm having a long day and you have five minutes to cheer me up. What do you do?
When did I surprise you by being more thoughtful or silly than you expected?
What's something romantic you've always wanted us to try on an ordinary weekday?
Leaving an unexpected note in my pocket or sending me a private playlist?
A partner knowing your exact food order is a quiet kind of flirtation. Does it count?
We must pick an entirely new hobby for two weekends. What are you signing us up for?
What's the most attractive part of how we handle disagreements?
Little moments of intentional eye contact deserve more credit in long relationships. Do you agree?
Tell me about a time we turned a boring errand into a date without planning to.
Our own made-up handshake or a secret code for 'meet me outside'?
What's the kindest way to interrupt me when I'm taking life too seriously?
You choose one song as the soundtrack to a night we'll remember. What's playing?
Sometimes sitting next to each other doing separate things feels surprisingly close. Romantic or not?
What would make you feel celebrated on a day with no special occasion?
A surprise lunch delivery or a handwritten invitation to a simple evening out?
We get lost somewhere new with an empty afternoon. Who takes charge, and who gets distracted?
Which small act of affection from our early days would you like us to bring back?
What's a playful challenge you'd love to win against me?
Sometimes the most romantic answer is, 'I already took care of it.' Agree or disagree?
You have to introduce me as a character in a romantic comedy. What's my entrance scene?
Which part of our future together makes you smile even when you haven't told me?
Two tickets to something neither of us understands or dinner at our familiar favourite place?
The way a couple greet each other after a short trip often says more than their holiday photos. Thoughts?
What is one ordinary conversation with me you wish you'd recorded because it made you laugh so hard?
We're playing a game where every answer earns us a date idea. What's the first question you ask?
What should we do this month to make our relationship feel a little more playful?
